title: Backend Engineer
content: <p>Acme builds tools that help small teams ship reliable software.</p><p>You will design, build and operate backend services in Python and Go that power our scheduling product.</p><p>You will work closely with product and design to turn customer problems into simple, well tested features.</p><ul><li>We care about clear code reviews, careful on call habits and writing things down so the next person can follow.</li><li>Requirements: two or more years building web services, comfort with SQL databases, and experience with cloud deployments.</li><li>Nice to have: experience with queues, observability tooling, and helping a small team grow its engineering practice.</li></ul><p>This role is remote within Canada. We offer flexible hours, a learning budget and a home office stipend.</p><p>Our interview process has three short conversations: a chat about your past work, a practical exercise on a small codebase, and a meeting with the team you would join.</p>
